newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia wool indicator up nine cents at 696c/kg.
newsitem.headline: Australia wool indicator up nine cents at 696c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator rose nine cents to 696 cents a kg clean on Wednesday at sales in Sydney and Melbourne, Wool International (WI) said in its daily market report.
Merino fleece was dearer, with 19/20/25/26 microns up one percent, 21/24m up 1.5 percent and 22/23m up two percent, while merino skirtings were up to 2.5 percent dearer.
In crossbreds, 27m was 0.5 percent dearer, and 28/29/30/31m one percent dearer. In cardings, lambs and locks were fully firm with crutchings slightly dearer.
